text:
Rae (growth): Heads-up: post-webinar tidy plan needed. We pushed the new landing; want redirects, JSON-LD, internal anchor stitching, and a quick redirect QA run within 48h.

Marco (seo): Agreed. Priority checklist: 1) 301 legacy promo pages -> /webinar-june-2026 2) add Event + BreadcrumbList JSON-LD on landing only 3) update 8 pillar pages with contextual links 4) make old thank-you pages noindex.

Jen L.: I'll update CTAs in blog posts and the benchmarks page. Also propose CTA A/B copy: "Watch: Serving at Scale" vs "View latency & cost benchmarks" (60/40 to benchmarks).

Ben (eng): Need list of legacy paths and param whitelist for redirects. Also confirm shortlink behavior (/s/webinar).

Rae (growth): Legacy paths: /promo/ai-launch, /events/prev-webinar, /thank-you/wv1, shortlink /s/webinar. Keep utm_source and utm_campaign; strip session_id and legacy_ref. /s/webinar -> 302 for 72h then flip to 301.

Ben (eng): Draft nginx rules for staging (handy for PR): ```# legacy exact
location = /promo/ai-launch { return 301 https://redwood.inference/webinar-june-2026?$query_string; }
rewrite ^/events/prev-webinar(.*)$ /webinar-june-2026$1 permanent; # preserves qs
location = /s/webinar { return 302 https://redwood.inference/webinar-june-2026; }``` Will add param whitelist to drop session_id.

Marco (seo): JSON-LD snippet (place in <head> of the landing, trimmed): {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference: Serving at Scale","startDate":"2026-06-10T17:00:00Z","url":"https://redwood.inference/webinar-june-2026","organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}}. Also add BreadcrumbList.

ops-bot: Staging deploy completed: 2026-06-10T02:15:00Z. Redirects queued for staging.

Jen L.: Anchor list: /benchmarks -> "inference benchmarks"; /optimize -> "reduce inference cost"; /docs/canaries -> "model canary deploys"; I'll drop CSV in content drive.

Marco (seo): QA steps post-deploy: run crawl to verify 301s, validate structured data with Rich Results test, confirm canonical is self-referential on new landing, ensure old TY pages are noindex, and capture link equity snapshot pre/post.

Ben (eng): Eng will include rollback: comment redirect block, reload nginx, purge CDN. Tagging eng-oncall for 48h monitoring.

Rae (growth): Owners: redirects=Ben, anchors=Jen, schema=Marco, monitoring=eng-oncall. We'll run an internal link audit 48h after live and reconvene here. Thanks :rocket:
